recommendedUnityImport.note: DO NOT import raw sheets as in-game sprites: backgrounds are opaque and photorealistic resolution mismatches the 0.58m cutaway cast. Import only after artist cleanup (transparent PNG, <=256px tall parts, bottom-center pivot, 512 PPU).

runtimeUse.immediate: NpcWardrobeVariantCatalog palettes sampled from these sheets drive the 8-layer Spine compositor (colors + skin tones + scale), giving 12 deterministic profession variants with zero binary import.
runtimeUse.sliced: frontview.png sliced into 49 validated transparent parts (see resident-wardrobe-parts-v1.spec.json); WardrobePartCatalog binds them to rig slots with palette fallback. Side/back views remain reference.

integrationConstraints: status is proposed-source-art, never validated-asset-candidate: opaque backgrounds fail the transparency gate in Docs/05_ASSET_PIPELINE.md.
Never rename a released content ID; the 6 npc.resident.*.v1 IDs stay immutable. New visual variety ships as wardrobe variants, not new resident IDs.
Pivot anchor strictly bottom-center (0.5, 0.0); world height normalized to 0.58m.
Skeletal rig must stay Spine 4.2 bone-compatible (resident-spine-setup-v1.json).
